description: This file defines the SharedProductsSheetPopulator class responsible for populating an Excel sheet with share product data, including product details and associated charges. It manages sheet layout, data writing, and derives market prices based on market data and current date.

classes.name: SharedProductsSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates a spreadsheet sheet with share product information, including product details, market prices, and associated charges.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates and populates the shared products sheet within the provided workbook, then protects the sheet.

methods.name: populateSheet
methods.description: Fills the sheet with share product data, setting up each row with product information and charges, and indexing charge positions.

methods.name: deriveMarketPrice
methods.description: Calculates the market price for a share product based on its market data and current date.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Defines the layout of the sheet, including header row and column widths.
